name: Vlad
source:
A man shrouded in the most ethereal beauty, he is actually a pure-blooded vampire. Once good friends with le Comte de Saint-Germain, they went their separate ways several hundred years ago.
It seems that certain grand ambitions of Vlad's may have something to do with their parting.

"I love this world... to the point of madness."
